Start date: 1793-09-23  
Add 46 weeks = 322 days.  
Add 2 more days → total 324 days.  

1793 is not a leap year (1792 was leap, next 1796).  
Days from Sep 23 to end of 1793:  
Sep: 7 (24–30)  
Oct: 31  
Nov: 30  
Dec: 31  
Total = 7+31+30+31 = 99 days.  

324 − 99 = 225 days into 1794.  
1794 is not leap (365 days).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days.  
225 days before Aug 31: 243 − 225 = 18 days before Aug 31 → Aug 13.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1794-08-13
